the conference, bringing together leading voices in frontier
quantum research and intelligent technologies for a substantive
exchange of ideas on how these ﬁelds are reshaping science and
society.
A special interaction with school students from Chennai
added a meaningful dimension to the event. Young participants
had the opportunity to engage with some of the ﬁnest minds in
global science, an experience that many found both rare and
inspiring.
Prof. Ahuja also felicitated Prof. Bawendi during the event,
recognising his exceptional contributions to science and
underlining the importance of honouring curiosity, excellence, and
collaborative thinking in research.
The participation reﬂected IIT Ropar's continued focus on
global scientiﬁc engagement and its commitment to inspiring the
next generation of researchers and innovators.
ANNAM.AI Receives USD 2 Million Grant from
Google to Drive AI-Powered Agriculture
ANNAM.AI, the AI Centre of Excellence at IIT Ropar,
received a grant of USD 2 million from Google to advance AI-
powered, climate-resilient, and data-driven agriculture in India.
The funding marked a signiﬁcant recognition of IIT Ropar's work in
applying artiﬁcial intelligence to one of the country's most critical
sectors.
The grant was part of Google's broader investment in
India's AI ecosystem, aimed at strengthening national research
capabilities and supporting innovations that serve public purpose.
The initiative was guided by Google's emphasis on translating
laboratory-level research into real-world, scalable impact.
With this support, ANNAM.AI took on an expanded
mandate in the area of digital agriculture. The focus areas included
enhancing crop intelligence and precision farming, improving
farmer productivity and resilience, developing AI models that
strengthen India's Digital Public Infrastructure, and driving a
sustainable, technology-enabled transformation of the agricultural
sector.
The grant positioned IIT Ropar as a leading institution in
India's AI for Bharat movement, contributing to the national vision
of a food-secure and technologically empowered future.
IIT Ropar Hosts International Conference on
Physics Education 2025
IIT Ropar hosted the IUPAP International Conference on
Physics Education (ICPE) 2025, welcoming an impressive gathering
of physicists, educators, researchers, and policymakers from across
India and around the world for ﬁve days of dialogue, discovery, and
collaboration.
The conference was held under the theme "Preparing for
the Future in the Age of Virtual Labs, AI, and Quantum
Technologies," reﬂecting the growing need to reimagine how
physics is taught and learned in a rapidly evolving technological
environment.
The inaugural session featured an address by Prof. Ajay
Kumar Sood, Principal Scientiﬁc Advisor to the Government of
India, who set the tone for the discussions that followed over the
course of the conference.
The ﬁve-day programme was structured to offer a rich mix
of academic and professional engagement. It included keynote talks
by leading voices in physics and education, hands-on workshops,
dedicated sessions on AI in physics and quantum technologies, and
career counselling for young researchers and students. All
participants received certiﬁcates of participation.
The conference was supported by government bodies,
academic institutions, ecosystem partners, and industry leaders,
and brought together a wide cross-section of stakeholders
committed to advance physics education at the global level.
Dr. Mukesh Kumar Honoured with IOP Publishing
Top Cited Paper Award
Dr. Mukesh Kumar, Professor in the Department of
Physics at IIT Ropar, received the IOP Publishing Top Cited Paper
Award for India in the Review Category for the period 2022 to 2024.
The award recognised his research paper on MoS -based photo
detectors, published in the Journal of Physics D: Applied Physics.
The IOP Publishing Top Cited Paper Award is given to
research that has demonstrated exceptional impact within the
scientiﬁc community. Dr. Kumar's work in the area of two-
dimensional materials and photo detection technologies drew
considerable attention from researchers globally, as reﬂected in the
high citation count his paper accumulated over the award period.
His contributions to optoelectronics and applied physics
have helped advance both the understanding and practical
applications of these technologies, areas that are increasingly
important to modern science and industry.
The recognition added to an already distinguished
academic record. Dr. Kumar was previously named a Fellow of the
Institute of Physics, UK, among other notable honours throughout
his career.
The award was seen as a reﬂection of the kind of high-
quality, impactful research that IIT Ropar has consistently
encouraged and supported across its departments.
IIT Ropar Researchers Develop Breakthrough
Platform for Precision Bacterial Detection
Researchers at the Department of Chemistry, IIT Ropar,
developed a novel platform for detecting harmful bacteria with
signiﬁcantly greater precision, offering a promising step forward in
the global effort to combat antimicrobial resistance.
The research was led by Dr. Anupam Bandyopadhyay and
his team, who demonstrated that introducing boronic acid into
a n t i m i c ro b i a l p e p t i d e s , c re at i n g w h at a re k n o w n a s
boronopeptides, enhanced bacterial detection performance by
nearly 40 times. The approach enabled selective imaging of Gram-
positive bacteria without causing harm to mammalian cells,
addressing a longstanding challenge in the ﬁeld of bacterial
diagnostics.
The study was published in Nature Communications, one
of the most respected journals in the natural sciences, with an
impact factor of 18. The paper was titled "An Efﬁcient Method for
Site-Selective Boronation of Peptides and Proteins Applied in
Magniﬁed Bacterial Imaging."
T h e ﬁ n d i n g s o p e n e d n e w p o s s i b i l i t i e s fo r t h e
development of next-generation bacterial imaging agents and
represented a meaningful contribution to efforts aimed at
addressing the growing threat of antimicrobial resistance
worldwide.
The publication also marked a signiﬁcant milestone for IIT
Ropar, as it stood among the highest-impact research outputs
published by the institute in recent times.
IIT Ropar Marks 16 Days of Activism Against
Gender-Based Violence
As part of the global 16 Days of Activism for Ending
Gender-Based Violence, observed annually from 25 November to
10 December, the Women's Forum and ICC Committee of IIT Ropar
organised an awareness programme on campus aimed at building a
safer, more inclusive, and better-informed campus community.
The programme featured two sessions by distinguished
speakers. Advocate Lalit Mohan Chanana delivered a talk on the
POSH Act, the BNS Act, and related legal provisions, helping
participants gain a clearer understanding of their legal rights,
institutional responsibilities, and the support mechanisms
available to them. Dr. Pam Rajput, an academic and feminist activist
of considerable standing, spoke on gender equality, the importance
of consent, and the role of positive masculinity in fostering a
culture of respect and allyship.
The event also celebrated student participation through
the announcement of results for a Digital Reel Competition, in
which students created short digital narratives around themes of
consent, respect, equality, and positive masculinity. Jyoti Giri and
Gursimran Kaur were named the winners of the competition.
The programme reﬂected the institute's ongoing
commitment to awareness, open dialogue, and collective action in
working toward an end to gender-based violence and the
strengthening of a respectful campus culture.

IIT Ropar Signs MoU with Dr. K.N. Modi University
to Advance AI and Innovation
IIT Ropar and Dr. K.N. Modi University, Modinagar signed
a Memorandum of Understanding on 11 December 2025,
formalising a partnership aimed at advancing Artiﬁcial
Intelligence, Cyber-Physical Systems, and entrepreneurship across
both institutions.
The MoU was signed by Prof. Rajeev Ahuja, Director, IIT
Ropar, and Dr. Pushpendra P. Singh, Dean (CAPS), IIT Ropar, along
with Dr. P.N. Hrisheekesha, Vice Chancellor, and Mr. Ajay Prajapati,
Training and Placement Ofﬁcer, from Dr. K.N. Modi University.
Under the terms of the agreement, the two institutions
planned to collaborate across several key areas. These included an
AI Minor Programme designed to meet the needs of both industry
and academia, the establishment of a Cyber-Physical Systems
laboratory, support for a startup ecosystem through incubation
facilities, funding access, and mentorship, as well as student and
faculty exchange programmes to encourage skill development and
joint research.
The partnership was seen as a meaningful step toward
building stronger academic and industry linkages, and toward
making cutting-edge technology education more accessible across
institutions.
IIT Ropar Hosts 10th International Conference on
Computer Vision and Image Processing
The 10th International Conference on Computer Vision
and Image Processing, CVIP 2025, got underway at IIT Ropar,
bringing together researchers, technologists, and academics for
four days of research presentations, technical sessions, and
professional networking.
The inaugural session featured addresses from several
distinguished guests. Dr. JBV Reddy, Mission Director of the
National Quantum Mission, participated virtually and spoke about
the growing convergence of quantum technology and artiﬁcial
intelligence. He drew attention to the signiﬁcant opportunities
emerging in quantum sensing and stressed the need for a strong
startup and academia ecosystem to support India's innovation
journey.
Prof. Rajeev Ahuja, Director, IIT Ropar, spoke on the role of
AI-driven missions in transforming sectors such as agriculture,
smart cities, and healthcare. He encouraged deeper collaboration
between industry and national research institutions as a way to
accelerate progress in these areas.
Prof. Mahesh Govil, Director, NIT Sikkim, addressed the
future of edge computing and computer vision, and underlined the
importance of collective effort in realising the vision of Viksit
Bharat.
The formal proceedings were opened by Conference
Chairs Dr. Puneet Goyal and Dr. Santosh Kumar Vipparthi, who
delivered the concluding remarks of the inaugural session and
welcomed all delegates to the conference.
Shri Dinkar Gupta, Former DG NIA, Appointed as
Professor of Practice at IIT Ropar
IIT Ropar announced the appointment of Shri Dinkar
Gupta, former Director General of the National Investigation
Agency (NIA), as Professor of Practice at the Defence Research
Innovation Foundation (DRIF) and the School of AI and Data
Engineering.
Shri Gupta brought with him decades of experience at the
highest levels of national security and public administration. His
areas of expertise spanned national security and defence policy,
internal security and counterterrorism, intelligence and
investigation of national security threats, and public policy,
strategic planning, and innovation governance.
The appointment was seen as a signiﬁcant step in
strengthening IIT Ropar's engagement with defence research and
strategic affairs, and in building meaningful connections between
academia and the country's national security ecosystem.
His association with both DRIF and the School of AI and
Data Engineering reﬂected the institute's intent to bring
practitioner knowledge into its research and academic
programmes, particularly in areas where experience at the ground
level holds considerable value.

IIT Ropar Signs MoU with Military Engineer
Services for Defence Infrastructure Research
IIT Ropar signed a Memorandum of Understanding with
Military Engineer Services, Ministry of Defence, Government of
India, on 3 December 2025, to jointly undertake a study on the
feasibility and estimation of future-ready military infrastructure.
The MoU was signed by Shri Bharat Singh Laspal, Chief
Engineer, Lucknow Zone, and Prof. Rajeev Ahuja, Director, IIT
Ropar.
The collaboration was aimed at exploring engineering
solutions that are innovative, sustainable and resilient, with a focus
on enhancing the operational efﬁciency and long-term reliability of
military infrastructure. The partnership also sought to examine
advanced energy-efﬁcient systems that could reduce logistical
dependencies and support improved endurance in demanding
operational environments.
The initiative was carried out under the aegis of the IIT
Ropar Defence Research and Innovation Foundation, which has
been working to position the institute as a research and innovation
hub at the intersection of academia, the armed forces, and industry.
The foundation has been actively engaged in driving applied
research, promoting indigenous technologies, and contributing to
strategic infrastructure development for national security.
Prof. Rajeev Ahuja Felicitated at CANDEE 2025
for Contributions to Research and Innovation
Prof. Rajeev Ahuja, Director, IIT Ropar, was felicitated at
the 4th International Conference on Advances in Nanomaterials
and Devices for Energy and Environment (CANDEE 2025), hosted
by Atal Bihari Vajpayee Indian Institute of Information Technology
and Management (ABV-IIITM), Gwalior.
Invited as a Key Speaker, Prof. Ahuja delivered a talk on
recent developments in nanomaterials and sustainable energy
solutions. Beyond his address, he was honoured for his long-
standing contributions to research and innovation, his role in
mentoring young researchers, and his engagement in shaping
impactful academic discussions at forums of this nature.
Prof. Ahuja's research record speaks to the scale of his
inﬂuence in the global scientiﬁc community. With over 52,000
citations and an H-index of 106, his work in the ﬁeld has had a
lasting and wide-reaching impact on research directions across
institutions worldwide.
The recognition at CANDEE 2025 was a further
afﬁrmation of IIT Ropar's standing as an institution committed to
research excellence and meaningful participation in international
scientiﬁc discourse.
IIT Ropar Research Scholars Contribute to India's
Semiconductor Milestone
IIT Ropar was part of a signiﬁcant moment in India's
semiconductor journey as the ofﬁcial handover of an advanced
semiconductor chip, fabricated by SCL Mohali, took place in the
presence of Shri Ashwini Vaishnaw, Hon’ble Union Minister for
Electronics and Information Technology.
Three different chips were designed by IIT Ropar research
scholars as part of this effort. The team comprised Rahul Walia,
Puneet Singh, Krishan Mehra, Mayank Kumar Singh, Hirensh
Mehra, and Upendra Chichhula, whose work formed a key
component of the MEITY Chips to Startup (C2S) project awarded to
IIT Ropar.
The project was carried out under the leadership of Prof.
Rohit Sharma, Dr. Mahendra Sakare, and Dr. Devarshi Das, whose
guidance was central to the successful execution of this technically
demanding work.
The achievement was widely seen as a meaningful
contribution to India's vision of technological self-reliance and to
the country's growing ambitions in semiconductor manufacturing
and design. For IIT Ropar, it represented the kind of applied, high-
impact research that brings together institutional capability and
national purpose.
IIT Ropar Observes Constitution Day with Preamble
Reading and Essay Competition
IIT Ropar marked Constitution Day with a series of
activities that brought together faculty, staff, and students in a
collective observance of the values enshrined in the Constitution of
India.
The highlight of the day was a joint reading of the
Preamble to the Constitution, which served as a moment of shared
reafﬁrmation of the principles of Justice, Liberty, Equality, and
IIT Ropar and Indian Army Sign MoU to Explore
Geothermal Technology for Defence Infrastructure
IIT Ropar signed a Memorandum of Understanding with
the Central Command, Indian Army on 19 November 2025,
initiating a collaboration focused on exploring the feasibility of
geothermal building technology for use in defence infrastructure.
The MoU was signed by Lt. Gen. Navin Sachdeva, Chief of
Staff, Central Command, and Prof. Rajeev Ahuja, Director, IIT Ropar.
The signing took place in the presence of Lt. Gen. Anindya
S e n g u p t a P V S M , U Y S M , AV S M , Y S M , G e n e ra l O fﬁ c e r
Commanding-in-Chief, Central Command, Dr. Atharva Poundarik,
Director of the IIT Ropar Defence Research Innovation Foundation
(DRIF) and Head of the Centre of Excellence for Studies and Applied
Research in Defence and Security (CoE-SARDS), and Dr.
Muthulingam Subramaniyan, Associate Professor in the
Department of Civil Engineering.
Prof. Rajeev Ahuja also performed the groundbreaking
ceremony to formally mark the commencement of the project.
The collaboration was aimed at developing sustainable, energy-
resilient infrastructure solutions for the armed forces. The research
was expected to explore how geothermal systems, drawing on
clean and renewable thermal energy, could reduce energy
dependency, improve operational endurance in extreme
environments, and enhance the overall efﬁciency of defence
infrastructure over the long term.
The initiative was carried out under the framework of IIT
Ropar's Defence Research Innovation Foundation, which has been
working to connect academic research with the operational needs
of the armed forces and industry.
Fraternity that form the foundation of India's democratic
framework.
The day also featured an essay competition in which
participants presented their thoughts and perspectives on
constitutional values and their relevance to contemporary life. The
entries reﬂected a genuine engagement with the ideals of
democracy and the responsibilities that come with citizenship.
The observance was in keeping with IIT Ropar's belief that
the development of an informed and conscientious community is as
important as the pursuit of academic and research excellence.
IIT Ropar Signs MoU with Pattern India to
Strengthen Industry-Academia Collaboration
IIT Ropar signed a Memorandum of Understanding with
Pattern India, formalising a partnership aimed at advancing
collaborative research, innovation, and talent development. The
agreement was signed by Prof. Rajeev Ahuja, Director, IIT Ropar,
and Mr. Nilesh Biniwale, General Manager, Pattern India.
The MoU brought together the academic strengths of IIT
Ropar with the industry expertise of Pattern India, with the intent
to work jointly on research and academic exchange, knowledge
transfer, and the creation of impactful initiatives at the intersection
of academia and industry.
The collaboration also sought to open up opportunities for
students and faculty to engage with real-world challenges,
contributing to the development of future-ready professionals and
solutions.
The partnership was in keeping with IIT Ropar's broader
commitment to building strong industry linkages that complement
and enrich its academic and research programmes.
IIT Ropar Signs MoU with DigiMantra to Foster
Industry-Aligned Learning and Innovation
IIT Ropar signed a Memorandum of Understanding with
DigiMantra, establishing a formal partnership aimed at
strengthening the connection between academic learning and
industry practice. The agreement was signed by Dr. Pushpendra P.
Singh, Dean, CAPS (Corporate, Alumni, Placement and Strategies),
IIT Ropar, and Mr. Bikramjit Singh, Global Vice President,
DigiMantra.
The collaboration was designed to bring together the
research and academic capabilities of IIT Ropar with DigiMantra's
industry experience, with a focus on delivering outcomes that
beneﬁt students, faculty, and the broader professional ecosystem.
Under the agreement, both institutions committed to
work jointly on research and innovation programmes addressing
real-world challenges and emerging technologies. The partnership
also envisaged the development of industry-aligned learning
pathways, supported by curriculum inputs, mentorship, and
exposure to current workforce needs. Additionally, students were
to be provided with internship, incubation, and applied learning
opportunities through engagement with live industry projects.
The MoU reﬂected a shared intent to support student
development, accelerate ideas from conception to application, and
prepare the next generation of professionals for the demands of a
rapidly evolving industry landscape.
IIT Ropar Signs MoU with Gujarat Technological
University for Academic Collaboration
IIT Ropar signed a Memorandum of Understanding with
Gujarat Technological University (GTU), marking the beginning of a
formal academic partnership between the two institutions. The
MoU was signed by Prof. Rajeev Ahuja, Director, IIT Ropar.
The partnership was aimed at building a sustained and
mutually beneﬁcial relationship across research, education, and
institutional development. Under the agreement, the two
institutions planned to pursue joint research initiatives and
interdisciplinary projects, facilitate student and faculty exchange
programmes, organise collaborative workshops, conferences, and
academic events, and enable shared access to laboratories,
resources, and areas of expertise.
The collaboration was seen as a step toward creating
broader and more diverse opportunities for students and
researchers at both institutions, while contributing to a stronger
ecosystem for engineering education and applied research.
IIT Ropar Signs MoU with iDG10 to Advance
Subsea Pipeline Technology Training in India
IIT Ropar signed a Memorandum of Understanding with
iDG10, initiating what was described as a ﬁrst-of-its-kind
collaboration in India aimed at advancing the digitisation of subsea
pipeline technology design and training.
The MoU was signed by Prof. Rajeev Ahuja, Director, IIT
Ropar, and Ms. Pallavi Tyagi, Director, Marketing and Business
Development, iDG10. The course under this collaboration is to be
coordinated by Prof. Dhiraj Kumar Mahajan at IIT Ropar.
The partnership was conceived to bridge the gap between
academic institutions and the oil and gas industry by providing
engineers and professionals with structured, industry-aligned
training in subsea pipeline systems used for gas and oil
transportation. iDG10 had already developed a dedicated software
platform for this purpose, and the MoU shifted the focus toward
training and capacity-building to ensure that professionals in
India's energy sector are equipped with both the tools and the
knowledge required to operate at a global standard.
The collaboration also opened the door to special joint
projects aimed at improving innovation, efﬁciency, and
competitiveness in subsea infrastructure development, with
implications for India's long-term energy resilience.
IIT Ropar Hosts Three-Day Rashtriya Karmayogi
Master Trainer Workshop
IIT Ropar hosted a three-day Master Trainer Workshop
under the Rashtriya Karmayogi programme from 3 to 5 November
2025, as part of the broader Mission Karmayogi framework
initiated by the Government of India.
The workshop brought together professionals committed
to the values of citizen-centric governance and public service.
Through immersive sessions and collaborative learning formats,
participants engaged with the principles of Seva Bhav, the spirit of
selﬂess service, and worked toward aligning their approach with
the national vision of a Viksit Bharat as articulated by the Prime
Minister.
The programme was aimed at preparing Master Trainers
who could carry forward the ethos of Mission Karmayogi within
their respective organisations, contributing to the development of a
civil service grounded in integrity, responsiveness, and a strong
sense of purpose.
IIT Ropar Hosts Student Interaction Programme
on Internal Security and Youth Awareness
IIT Ropar hosted a Students' Interaction Programme in
collaboration with Prajna Pravah, bringing together over 180
students from seven engineering institutions across the region. The
programme was themed around internal security through youth
awareness, with discussions centred on the challenges facing a
resurgent India and the role that young professionals can play in
shaping the country's future.
Prof. Rajeev Ahuja, Director, IIT Ropar, addressed the
s t u d e n t s a n d e n c o u ra g e d t h e m t o p u r s u e d e e p - t e c h
entrepreneurship and to direct their professional ambitions toward
solving challenges of national signiﬁcance. Sh. Chandra Kant,
Northern Region Convenor, Prajna Pravah, offered a broader
perspective on global societal issues and urged students to stay
informed and alert as India's standing on the world stage continues
to grow.
The programme featured open discussions on several
themes of contemporary relevance, including the role of social
media in shaping public narratives, the implications of AI and data
ownership, the need for indigenous technology platforms, and the
importance of technological self-reliance for national security.
The event refected a shared commitment among the participating
institutions and organisations to encourage informed, engaged, and
responsible participation by young people in the national
discourse.

IIT Ropar Celebrates Sustainability with Best Out
of Waste Competition
The Stores and Purchase Section of IIT Ropar organised a
Best Out of Waste competition on 28 October 2025, as part of the
Special Campaign for Disposal of Pending Matters (SCDPM 5.0). The
event brought together students, children, staff, and faculty in a
shared effort to promote recycling, sustainability, and the creative
reuse of discarded materials.
Participants worked with everyday waste items including
old newspapers, plastic bottles, fabric remnants, cardboard, and
polythene, transforming them into decorative pieces, functional
eco-friendly objects, and artistic models. The range and quality of
entries reﬂected the enthusiasm with which the campus
community took on the challenge.
Prof. Rajeev Ahuja, Director, IIT Ropar, commended the
participants for their commitment to sustainability and
encouraged the community to carry the spirit of the competition
into their daily routines by adopting more environmentally
conscious practices.
The event served as a reminder that small, purposeful
actions can contribute meaningfully to larger goals, and that
creativity and responsibility go hand in hand when it comes to
building a more sustainable environment.
IIT Ropar Conducts Pilot Drone Training Programme
for Army Ofﬁcers and JCOs
The Centre of Drones and Autonomous Systems (DRAS)
and the Defence Research Innovation Foundation (DRIF) at IIT
Ropar successfully conducted a three-week Pilot Drone Training
Programme from 6 to 25 October 2025 for the ﬁrst batch of 25 Army
Ofﬁcers and Junior Commissioned Ofﬁcers/Other Ranks
(JCOs/ORs) from across the country, under the aegis of the Army
Training Command (ARTRAC).
The programme offered participants a comprehensive
learning experience covering both theoretical and practical aspects
of drone technology. The curriculum included drone building and
integration, drone data processing and analysis, DGCA-authorised
Drone Pilot Training, and advanced modules on Counter-UAS,
Drone Warfare, and Autonomous Systems.
The valedictory ceremony was addressed by Lt. Gen.
Surinder Singh Mahal (Retd.), PVSM AVSM VSM, Director, IIT
Ropar Defence Research and Innovation Foundation (DRIF), who
congratulated the participants and spoke about the growing
importance of drone technology in modern warfare and the need
for the armed forces to stay at the forefront of these developments.
Dr. Shashi Shekhar Jha, Coordinator, DRAS, expressed
conﬁdence that the hands-on training and knowledge gained
during the programme would strengthen the participants'
operational understanding of drones and their application as a
transformative technology on the battleﬁeld.
The programme was seen as a meaningful step toward
building indigenous capability and producing mission-ready drone
professionals for India's defence needs.
IIT Ropar and ICMR-NIRDHS Sign MoU to
Advance Digital Health Research
IIT Ropar and the ICMR National Institute for Research in
Digital Health and Data Sciences (ICMR-NIRDHS) signed a
Memorandum of Understanding to advance collaboration in digital
health, biomedical data analytics, and AI-driven healthcare
solutions.
The MoU was signed by Prof. Rajeev Ahuja, Director, IIT
Ropar, and Dr. Mona Duggal, Director, ICMR-NIRDHS, marking the
beginning of a long-term academic and research partnership
between the two institutions.
The collaboration was structured around several areas of
joint engagement. The two institutions planned to jointly develop
PhD and Master's programmes in digital health and data sciences,
pursue collaborative research projects, and submit joint proposals
to national and international funding agencies. The partnership
also included provisions for knowledge-sharing through
workshops and training programmes, as well as focused efforts to
address public health challenges through data-driven approaches.
The MoU reﬂected IIT Ropar's commitment to building
meaningful connections between engineering and healthcare
through translational research, while supporting the broader
national goal of strengthening India's digital health ecosystem.

IIT Ropar and TCS Research Sign MoU to Collaborate
on Deep-Tech and AI Solutions
IIT Ropar and Tata Consultancy Services Research signed a
Memorandum of Understanding, initiating a research partnership
with an initial focus on developing AI solutions for critical domains
including defence and internal security.
The MoU was signed by Prof. Rajeev Ahuja, Director, IIT
Ropar, and Dr. Harrick Vin, Chief Technology Ofﬁcer, TCS.
The collaboration was designed to bring together IIT
Ropar's academic and research capabilities with TCS Research's
expertise in applied technology, with the aim of working on
problems that sit at the frontier of deep-tech innovation. Beyond
the research agenda, the partnership also created a framework for
academic exchange, including the movement of researchers and
scholars between the two organisations, joint publications,
seminars, and workshops.
The agreement was seen as a signiﬁcant step for IIT Ropar
in building industry partnerships that are rooted in substantive,
long-term research collaboration rather than transactional
engagement.
IIT Ropar Conducts Three-Day Drone Technology
Training for Senior Government Ofﬁcials
The Centre for Drones and Autonomous Systems at IIT
Ropar conducted a three-day training programme on Drone
Technology and Its Applications from 13 to 15 October 2025,
organised under the aegis of the National e-Governance Division
(NeGD), Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology,
Government of India.
The programme brought together participants from 15
government departments and agencies, reﬂecting a wide cross-
section of the administration. Represented bodies included the
Department of Information Technology, Electronics and
Communications; Department of Revenue; Department of Home;
Department of Higher Education; Urban Development and Urban
Housing Department; Citizen Resources Information Department;
Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs; CRPF; Department of
Health Research; Department of Agriculture and Farmer Welfare;
MHA Informatics Division; NIC; Indian Mete orological
Department; Government of India Enterprise; and Ministry of
Defence.
Participants received hands-on exposure to drone
operations alongside sessions covering the technical foundations
and practical applications of drone technology across multiple
sectors. The programme also featured expert sessions from
industry professionals and visits to drone startups, offering
participants a closer look at India's growing drone ecosystem.
Prof. Rajeev Ahuja, Director, IIT Ropar, welcomed the
participants and encouraged them to explore the institute's
ongoing research in drones, AgriTech, AI and ML, materials, and
other emerging areas. Sh. Sunil Jain, Director, NeGD, commended
IIT Ropar's initiative and highlighted the importance of building
advanced training programmes in areas such as AI in drones and
related technologies.
The programme concluded with strong interest from
participants and reinforced the case for closer collaboration
between academia, industry, and government in building India's
capabilities as a centre for drone innovation.
IIT Ropar Signs MoU with Pinaca Technologies to
Strengthen Cybersecurity Research and Training
IIT Ropar signed a Memorandum of Understanding with
Pinaca Technologies, an Indian GovTech company working in the
areas of digital governance and national security, to establish a
partnership focused on cybersecurity research, training, and
innovation.
The collaboration was structured around several areas of
joint engagement. These included offensive security and red-team
training, the development of a cyber range and simulation
laboratory, research in adversarial AI and machine learning
security, and AI-driven cyber forensics and incident response. The
partnership also provided for joint certiﬁcate courses and student
internships, Capture-the-Flag (CTF) competitions and hackathon
programmes, as well as joint publications, patents, and product co-
development.
The MoU was seen as a signiﬁcant step in building a well-
rounded ecosystem for cybersecurity at IIT Ropar, one that
combined rigorous academic research with practical, real-world
readiness. The collaboration was also expected to create
meaningful opportunities for students to engage with the ﬁeld at a
level that goes beyond the classroom.

IIT Ropar Hosts Delegation from Missouri
University of Science and Technology to Explore
Dual PhD Programme
The Ofﬁce of International Relations at IIT Ropar
welcomed a delegation from Missouri University of Science and
Technology (Missouri S&T), USA, for discussions centred on the
possibility of launching a Dual PhD Degree Programme between
the two institutions.
The visiting delegation comprised Prof. Sajal K. Das,
Professor and Daniel St. Clair Endowed Chair of Computer Science,
and Ms. Jodi Hasekamp, Director of Graduate and International
Admissions at Missouri S&T. They were received by Prof. Rajeev
Ahuja, Director, IIT Ropar, and Prof. Rohit Sharma, Dean,
International Relations.
The visit provided an opportunity for both sides to explore
the academic and administrative framework that would be needed
to support a joint doctoral programme, and to identify areas of
research interest common to both institutions.
The discussions were seen as a step toward building a
deeper and more structured academic relationship between IIT
Ropar and Missouri S&T, and reﬂected the institute's ongoing
efforts to expand its global academic partnerships and create
research opportunities for its students at an international level.
BSF Delegation Visits IIT Ropar to Explore
Collaboration in Border Security Technologies
The IIT Ropar Defence Research and Innovation
Foundation (DRIF) hosted a delegation from the Border Security
Force (BSF) on 14 October 2025. The delegation was led by Shri
Sanjay Kumar Misra, Inspector General, BSF Institute of
Communication and Information Technology (BICIT), and included
Shri Ravinder Singh Chandel, Commandant, and Shri Ashish Behl,
Deputy Commandant.
The visit was aimed at identifying areas of collaboration
between BSF and IIT Ropar in the domain of border security.
Detailed technical discussions were held on a range of subjects
including advanc e d surveillanc e te chnologies, s e cure
communications such as Software Deﬁned Radio (SDR) and
quantum-resilient encryption, anti-drone and counter-UAS
systems, cybersecurity and Security Operations Centre (SOC)
capabilities, indigenous drone simulation technologies, and the
training of BSF personnel.
The visiting ofﬁcers also met with IIT Ropar faculty
working in research areas relevant to the BSF's operational needs,
including cybersecurity, quantum communication, SDR, natural
language processing, drone detection, and multi-weather buildings.
DRIF also presented its ongoing defence research and development
projects, alongside its DGCA-certiﬁed Drone Training and DGR
training programmes.
Shri Sanjay Kumar Misra, reﬂecting on the visit, noted
that while the delegation had arrived with speciﬁc operational
challenges in mind, the breadth of research and innovation they
encountered at IIT Ropar opened up a much wider set of
possibilities for future collaboration.
The visit concluded with a tour of the Central Research
Facility, and was seen as a promising step toward building strategic
partnerships between IIT Ropar and paramilitary forces in support
of indigenised, technology-driven solutions for border security and
defence.
IIT Ropar Observes World Mental Health Day
with Meditation and Mindfulness Session
The Snehita Wellbeing Cell and Board of Wellness Affairs
at IIT Ropar marked World Mental Health Day on 10 October 2025
with a session titled Meditation and Mindfulness for Holistic
Wellbeing.
The session was led by Dr. Ishan Shivanand and offered
participants practical tools for cultivating inner balance, emotional
clarity, and resilience in everyday life. The programme drew
participation from across the campus community and was received
as a meaningful opportunity for collective reﬂection on mental
health and wellbeing.
This year's global theme, Access to Services: Mental
Health in Catastrophes and Emergencies, underlined the
importance of ensuring that mental health support remains
available and accessible, particularly during times of crisis and
disruption.
The observance was in keeping with IIT Ropar's ongoing
commitment to building a campus culture that is compassionate,
inclusive, and proactive in addressing the wellbeing of every
individual in the community.

IIT Ropar Signs MoU with India Accelerator to
Strengthen Defence Start-Up Ecosystem
IIT Ropar signed a Memorandum of Understanding with
IA India Accelerator Pvt Ltd, a seed-stage technology fund-led
accelerator working in the areas of Defence Tech, Space Tech, and
Mobility. The collaboration was aimed at advancing India's self-
reliance in defence technologies through a stronger industry,
academia, and start-up ecosystem.
India Accelerator, recognised as one of the leading
accelerators in the country and recipient of the Best Start-Up
Accelerator of India award in 2021, brought to the partnership an
established network of technology start-ups and experienced
mentors. The MoU was signed in the presence of Prof. Rajeev
Ahuja, Director, IIT Ropar; Lt. Gen. Anil Chait (Retd.), representing
India Accelerator; Mr. Arindam Mukhopadhyay, Partner, VC, India
Accelerator; Lt. Gen. Surinder Singh Mahal, Professor of Practice
and Director, IIT Ropar Defence Research and Innovation
Foundation (DRIF); and Dr. Atharva Poundarik, Director, DRIF, IIT
Ropar.
The collaboration was structured around DRIF at IIT
Ropar and was intended to bring together the institute's technical
expertise with India Accelerator's partnerships in the start-up
space to drive meaningful progress in defence technology. The
initial focus areas included drones and counter-drone technologies,
as well as autonomous and robotic systems.
The agreement was seen as an important step in the joint
pursuit of technology incubation, indigenous capability
development, and research-backed solutions for the defence sector.
IIT Ropar Signs MoU with SSS-NIBE to Advance
Bioenergy Research
IIT Ropar signed a Memorandum of Understanding with
the Sardar Swaran Singh National Institute of Bio-Energy (SSS-
NIBE), Kapurthala, at the 5th International Conference on Recent
Advances in Bio-Energy Research (ICRABR-2025), hosted at SSS-
NIBE. The agreement marked the beginning of a formal research
partnership focused on biomass and bioenergy, with the broader
aim of contributing to India's transition toward clean and
renewable energy.
Prof. Rajeev Ahuja, Director, IIT Ropar, attended the
conference as Guest of Honour and addressed the gathering on the
importance of interdisciplinary collaboration, industry-academia
partnerships, and scientiﬁc innovation in developing sustainable
bio-based solutions. He underlined the need for the bioeconomy to
be placed at the centre of India's decarbonisation strategy and drew
attention to the role of biomass in enabling the production of green
hydrogen, a resource considered critical to the emergence of a
hydrogen-based energy economy.
The MoU was seen as a step toward building a sustained
and outcome-oriented collaboration between the two institutions,
one focused on research that is relevant to both national energy
priorities and global sustainability commitments.
IIT Ropar Hosts TEDx Event Bringing Together
Leaders Across Technology, Entrepreneurship
and Social Change
IIT Ropar hosted its TEDx event, organised by The
Enarrators, the institute's oratory club, in collaboration with the
Entrepreneurship Cell, an initiative of IIT Ropar's Technology
Business Incubator Foundation (TBIF). The event brought together
a diverse group of speakers whose talks spanned leadership,
technology, creativity, and social impact.
The stage was graced by eight speakers from varied
backgrounds and disciplines. Lt. Gen. Surinder Singh Mahal,
Lieutenant General, Indian Army, opened the programme to a
strong reception. Dr. Munish Jindal, Founder and CEO of
HoverRobotix, and Akshay Singh of EVIGWAY Technologies Pvt.
Ltd. represented the entrepreneurship and deep-tech space. Purvi
Roy, Co-Founder and CEO of AristaVault, and Bharulata Patel-
Kamble, CEO of Multi Super Speciality Hospital, brought
perspectives from healthcare and business leadership. Dr.
Dibyakusum Ray, Associate Professor at IIT Ropar, spoke from
within the academic community, while Saakshar Duggal, an

Artiﬁcial Law Expert and Author, addressed the intersection of law
and emerging technology. Sonali Sharma, Author and Motivational
Storyteller, rounded off the speaker lineup with a talk that
resonated with the broader audience.
Prof. Rajeev Ahuja, Director, IIT Ropar, Dr. Shray Pathak,
FIC and Director of TBIF, and Ms. Karuna Kanwar, Incubation
Manager at TBIF, felicitated the speakers and were present to
underscore the institute's commitment to conversations that
connect ideas with action.
Special recognition was extended to Saurabh Sharma,
whose initiative and sustained effort made it possible to bring the
TEDx platform to IIT Ropar, creating a new channel for thought
leadership and public discourse on campus.
IIT Ropar Conducts Campus Plantation Drive
IIT Ropar organised a Plantation Drive on campus, led by
Prof. Rajeev Ahuja, Director, IIT Ropar, and his spouse Ms. Sneh Lata
Ahuja, whose participation lent a personal and heartfelt dimension
to the initiative.
Together, they planted trees across the campus,
reinforcing the message that maintaining a clean and green
environment is a shared responsibility that extends beyond formal
programmes and institutional mandates.
The drive was part of IIT Ropar's broader commitment to
environmental care and sustainable campus development, and
reﬂected the institute's belief that a culture of ecological
responsibility is as important to nurture as academic and research
excellence.
IIT Ropar Concludes Swachhta Pakhwada with
Closing Ceremony
IIT Ropar marked the conclusion of its fortnight-long
Swachhta Pakhwada, observed from 17 September to 2 October,
with a closing ceremony that brought together members of the
campus community to reﬂect on the campaign and reafﬁrm their
commitment to cleanliness and sustainability.
Prof. Rajeev Ahuja, Director, IIT Ropar, addressed the
gathering and enc ourage d everyone to maintain clean
surroundings and take conscious steps toward making the campus
plastic-free. His address resonated with the spirit of the campaign
and served as a reminder that the values of Swachhta extend well
beyond a designated fortnight.
Mr. Deepak Phogat, Nodal Ofﬁcer, Swachhta Hi Sewa,
presented a summary of the activities carried out during the
campaign, which included cleanliness drives and awareness
sessions that engaged students, staff, and faculty across the
institute.
The ceremony concluded with a vote of thanks and the
distribution of tokens of appreciation to all those who contributed
to making the initiative a success.

Industry LYNK 2025 Opens at IIT Ropar with
Focus on Academia-Industry Collaboration
Industry LYNK 2025 was inaugurated at IIT Ropar,
bringing together representatives from academia and industry for
a day of dialogue, collaboration, and exchange of ideas on the
evolving relationship between the two sectors.
Dr. Pushpendra P. Singh, Dean, Corporate, Alumni,
Placement and Strategies, welcomed the speakers and dignitaries
and set the tone for the day's proceedings. In his inaugural address,
Prof. Rajeev Ahuja, Director, IIT Ropar, spoke on the need for a
closer and more sustained partnership between academia and
industry, and highlighted the institute's commitment to real-time
collaboration and to leveraging technology for sustainable and
future-oriented outcomes.
The event featured a keynote session by Varadharaju
Janardhanan, Chief Human Resources Ofﬁcer at Super Money, a
Flipkart Group company, who offered the audience a detailed
perspective on the current state of the industry and the shifts
shaping its future.
Industry LYNK 2025 was conceived as a platform to align
student talent, academic ideas, and industry requirements, and the
inaugural edition drew strong engagement from all participants.
IIT Ropar Signs MoU with Indian Air Force to
Advance Defence Technology and Indigenisation
IIT Ropar signed a Memorandum of Understanding with
the Indian Air Force on 24 September 2025, with Air Marshal Vijay
Kumar Garg, AVSM, VSM, Air Ofﬁcer Commanding-in-Chief, Air
Force Maintenance Command, Nagpur, signing the agreement
alongside Prof. Rajeev Ahuja, Director, IIT Ropar.
The MoU added another signiﬁcant chapter to IIT Ropar's
growing engagement with India's armed forces. The collaboration
was aimed at advancing the vision of Atmanirbharta by providing
technological support and facilitating industry partnerships in core
engineering domains and strategic national missions.
Dr. Atharva Poundarik, Director, IIT Ropar Defence
Research and Innovation Foundation (DRIF), welcomed the visiting
delegation from 3BRD Chandigarh and outlined the institute's
commitment to working closely with the Indian Air Force on the
indigenisation and testing of components, ofﬁcer training, and
product innovation and manufacturing.
During the visit, Air Marshal Garg and his delegation met
with faculty members and heads of engineering departments to
explore potential areas of joint work with the Maintenance
Command. The delegation also toured the Central Research Facility
(CRF) laboratories, where they received demonstrations of the
research capabilities and infrastructure available at the institute.
The visit and the MoU signing were seen as a strong
afﬁrmation of IIT Ropar's role as a collaborative hub for defence
sector research and innovation.
IIT Ropar and Headquarters Central Command
Sign MoUs for Defence Infrastructure Research
Headquarters Central Command signed multiple
Memorandums of Understanding with IIT Ropar to jointly
undertake three research and development projects focused on
building rapid-deployment and high-endurance infrastructure for
troops operating in extreme terrain and climatic conditions.
The MoUs were signed in the presence of Lt. Gen. Anindya
Sengupta, PVSM, UYSM, AVSM, YSM, G eneral O fﬁc er
Commanding-in-Chief, Central Command; Prof. Rajeev Ahuja,
Director, IIT Ropar; Lt. Gen. Navin Sachdeva, Chief of Staff, Central
Command; Dr. Atharva Poundarik, Director, IIT Ropar Defence
Research and Innovation Foundation (DRIF); Lt. Gen. S.S. Mahal
(Retd.), Professor of Practice, IIT Ropar; and Dr. S. Muthulingam,
Dean Infrastructure, IIT Ropar.
The three projects identiﬁed under the collaboration were
the development of a Multi-Weather Resilient Precast Habitat, a 3D
Pod Modular Precast Habitat Construction system, and
Lightweight Snow Supporting Structures for Avalanche Zones.
Each of these addressed a distinct operational challenge faced by
troops in remote and forward areas.
The technologies were designed to enhance survivability
and operational efﬁciency in difﬁcult environments, reduce
logistical burden and construction timelines, and build indigenous
capability in combat engineering. Taken together, the projects
represented a focused effort to develop soldier-centric solutions
that are practical, scalable, and suited to the demands of modern
operations.
The signing was seen as a signiﬁcant step forward in the
growing partnership between IIT Ropar and the Indian Army, and
in the broader pursuit of civil-military synergy through academic
research and engineering excellence.
IIT Ropar Hosts 46th All IITs Placement Committee
Meeting
IIT Ropar hosted the 46th All IITs Placement Committee
(AIPC) Meeting on 13 September 2025, bringing together the
Training and Placement Heads from all Indian Institutes of
Technology for their annual strategic gathering.
The meeting served as a forum for collective deliberation
on plac ement p olicies, student prepare dness, and the
strengthening of industry-academia collaboration across the IIT
ecosystem. With the job market continuing to evolve and industry
requirements shifting at a considerable pace, the annual meeting
has become an important occasion for the IITs to align their
approaches and share insights on effective placement practices.
IIT Ropar was also pleased to announce that Dr. Surya
Kant Sahdeo, Assistant Professor in the Department of Civil
Engineering, was elected as the new Co-convener of the AIPC. The
recognition was seen as a mark of conﬁdence in IIT Ropar's active
and constructive participation in the wider IIT community.
IIT Ropar Launches RISE Programme to Build
Mental Resilience Among Students
IIT Ropar launched RISE, Resilience in Students Every
Day, a structured programme developed in collaboration with
WHEELS Global Foundation, the not-for-proﬁt arm of PAN IIT
Global. The initiative was designed to address the growing
challenge of mental stress among students in higher education, and
to equip them with practical tools to adapt, recover, and perform
well under academic and personal pressure.
IIT Ropar was among the ﬁrst IITs to introduce a dedicated,
evidence-based programme of this nature. The initiative was
developed under the leadership of Prof. Rajeev Ahuja, Director, IIT
Ropar, and was led through a multidisciplinary approach by Dr.
Atharva Poundarik, Head, Department of Biomedical Engineering.
The launch was graced by Dr. Ishan Shivanand, a global speaker,
founder of Yoga of Immortals, and Adjunct Faculty at the Centre of
Excellence for Holistic Wellbeing, IIT Ropar. He introduced
students to practical techniques for emotional regulation and stress
management, encouraging them to take an active role in their own
wellbeing. Dr. Bindukumar Kansupada, Vice Chair of the WGF
Health Council and Adjunct Faculty in the Department of
Biomedical Engineering, spoke on the long-term importance of
mental wellness and its role in a student's overall development.
The launch of RISE reﬂected IIT Ropar's commitment to
building a campus environment where student wellbeing is treated
as a priority alongside academic achievement.
IIT Ropar Hosts Bootcamp to Advance Joint
Programmes with AIIMS Bathinda and Central
University of Punjab
IIT Ropar hosted a Bootcamp on 26 August 2025 to
advance joint academic programmes and research collaborations
with AIIMS Bathinda, building on the momentum of a recently
signed MoU between the two institutions.
The Bootcamp brought together faculty and researchers
from IIT Ropar, AIIMS Bathinda, and the Central University of
Punjab for discussions on interdisciplinary innovation and shared
priorities across healthcare, engineering, and wellbeing.
Participants from IIT Ropar included Dr. Jitendra Kumar,
Dean, Research and Development; Dr. Atharva Poundarik, Head of
Department, Biomedical Engineering; Dr. Navin Kumar, Head of
Department, Mechanical Engineering; and Dr. Suryasnata
Tripathy, who served as Coordinator for the MoU and the Centre of
Excellence on Holistic Wellbeing, along with other faculty
members.
The Bootcamp was aimed at identifying concrete areas for
collaboration in translational research and interdisciplinary
academic programming, with a focus on outcomes that would be
meaningful for academia, healthcare, and the broader community.
The initiative reﬂected IIT Ropar's commitment to building
partnerships that go beyond formal agreements and result in
sustained, impactful work across institutional boundaries.
IIT Ropar and SVNIT Surat Sign MoU to Launch
Joint PhD Programme
IIT Ropar and Sardar Vallabhbhai National Institute of
Te c h n o l o g y ( S V N I T ) S u rat s i g n e d a M e m o ra n d u m o f
Understanding to establish a Joint PhD Programme, bringing
together two premier engineering institutions in a formal research
collaboration.
The programme was designed to offer doctoral scholars
the beneﬁt of dual institutional guidance, giving them access to the
expertise, facilities, and academic environment of both institutions
simultaneously. The collaboration was aimed at fostering
interdisciplinary research, enabling shared access to research
infrastructure, and supporting co-mentorship of scholars across a
range of domains.
The Joint PhD Programme was seen as an opportunity to
create a richer and more stimulating research experience for
scholars, while also strengthening the overall research ecosystems
of both institutions through sustained academic interaction and
the cross-pollination of ideas.
IIT Ropar Weightlifting Team Finishes First
Runner-Up at General Championship
The IIT Ropar Weightlifting Team put up a strong
performance at the General Championship, ﬁnishing as First
Runner-Up in the overall standings. The result was a reﬂection of
consistent effort and preparation by the athletes across the
duration of the competition.
The team's showing was further marked by notable
individual performances in two weight categories. In the Under 60
kg category, Ujjal Das won the Silver Medal. In the Under +79 kg
category, Kartikey Sahu claimed the Silver Medal, while Napendra
Solanki added a Bronze Medal to the team's tally.
The achievement was widely appreciated across the
institute as a testament to the athletes' discipline and commitment
to their sport.

Infrastructure Development
IIT Ropar started functioning in the academic year 2008-09
from the campus of IIT Delhi, the mentor institute. The
foundation stone was laid on 24 February 2009 for the
permanent campus of IIT Ropar. IIT Ropar was initially
registered under the Societies Registration Act 1860 on 29
July 2008. Subsequently, the Institute was established by
an Act of Parliament, namely, the Institutes of Technology
(Amendment) Act 2012 (No. 34 of 2012). In just 15 years,
the institute stands tall as one of the fastest-growing
young-generation IITs in the country. The Institute has 25
Lacs Sq.ft. built-up area and constructed in three phases
i.e. Phase IA, IB and IC.
• The construction work has been entrusted to CPWD and
construction of Phase IC has been done by M/s NCC.
• The sub phase IC having a plinth area of 74,288 sqm has
been constructed with an estimated cost of Rupees 387
crores. The work has been completed on June 30, 2023.

Research Scholars Day
T h e D e p a r t m e n t o f
Computer Science and
Engineering and the
Department of Electrical
Engineering, IIT Ropar
celebrated Research
Scholars Day on April 8,
2023. The event included
interesting talks by Dr. N Kannan, Cadence; Mr. Rahul
Prasad, Bobble AI; Mr. Tarun Yadav, DRDO; Mr. Pravesh Jain,
CureFit; followed by poster presentations and
demonstrations by research scholars, Circuit-design and
Tech-crunch competitions and a panel discussion on the
impact of Generative AI on Research.
Director Message
Dear Members of the IIT Ropar
Community,
As we reﬂect upon the past
quarter, it is with immense
pride and gratitude that I
acknowledge the remarkable
a c c o m p l i s h m e n t s a n d
activities that have taken place
within our vibrant institution.
As we continue our journey of
academic excellence and
innovation, allow me to share
w i t h y o u s o m e o f t h e
signiﬁcant events that have enriched our campus and
strengthened our commitment to progress.. Our alma
mater rejoiced as we hosted our very ﬁrst Alumni Meet,
reconnecting with the individuals who contribute to our
legacy, embodying our motto of 'Karmasu Kaushalam'. The
campus came alive with the vibrant student symposium
"CESAFIESTA 1.0," where creativity, talent, and innovation
took the centre stage. Marking our commitment to global
concerns, occasions like the World Intellectual Property Day
and World Environment Day were observed, reinforcing our
responsibility towards sustainable development and
intellectual advancements. We hosted enlightening
sessions, including a talk on the awe-inspiring cycling
expedition in the Himalayas, promoting adventure, ﬁtness,
and determination. International Day of Yoga and National
Technology Day were celebrated with great fervor, reﬂecting
our dedication to the holistic well-being and technological
advancements. In the realm of industry collaboration, we
proudly announced our partnership with Samsung
Electronics, R&D, Noida, reinforcing our commitment to
innovation and industry-driven research. In addition to the
above there are many more achievements in research and
innovation, along with the awards and recognitions to our
esteemed faculties. These events and achievements stand
as a testament to the dynamic and holistic environment that
deﬁnes IIT Ropar. The quarter was ended with a remarkable
achievement, as IIT Ropar soared higher in rankings in
research category and overall category while maintaining
the ranking in Engineering category, a testament to the
collective dedication of our faculty, staﬀ, and students
towards excellence in education and research. I extend my
heartfelt appreciation to our exceptional faculty,
enthusiastic students, and dedicated staﬀ, as well as our
collaborators and well-wishers, for their unwavering
support.
Together, we continue to shape the future with excellence.
Jai Hind!
News, Events & Activities
IIT Ropar was ranked amongst the top 25 in NIRF rankings
2023. IIT Ropar has been placed 22nd in the Engineering
Category, 46th in Research, and 33rd in the Overall
Category. In research ranking we have entered the top 50
with the 46th rank, the ﬁrst time in the Institute’s history.
Ranking
IIT Ropar Organized a two days
Workshop “Metsoc”
M e t S o c S o c i e t y o f
M e t a l l u r g i c a l a n d
Materials Engineering
D e p a r t m e n t , I I T
Ropar,in collaboration
with INYAS, organized a
career workshop- ED-
VANTAGE at IIT Ropar
from April 01 to 02, 2023. The event's theme was to
share/discuss career opportunities for UG/PG/Ph.D.
students. The critical event in the workshop was Expert
talks and Open Sessions for better interaction with all
participants. Experts in Industries, Academia, and
inﬂuential personalities from the Army and Government
ﬁelds were invited.
1

IIT Ropar Organized a Student Symposium
“CESAFIESTA 1.0”
The Department
o f C i v i l
Engineering at IIT
R o p a r h a s
o r g a n i z e d t h e
CESAFIESTA 1.0, a
s t u d e n t
symposium, on
April 7–8, 2023.
M r . K u l w a n t
Kumar Sarangal,
ADGP Maharashtra joined was present for the inauguration
ceremony and graced the audience with word of wisdom
and motivation words.
The symposium witnessed expert talks, model building,
poster and oral presentations along with a technical quiz.
The director congratulated all the winners of the Quiz and
Model Building competition and acknowledged the eﬀorts
of scholars for their Oral/Poster presentations. The event
was sponsored by AIMIL, HEICO, ALLTERRA & Bawarchi
restaurant for the smooth conduct of the event.
World Intellectual Property Day, 2023
IIT Ropar celebrated
World IP Day, 2023 with
the theme “Women
and IP: Accelerating
i n n o v a t i o n a n d
creativity” by giving
c e r t i ﬁ c a t e o f
a p p r e c i a t i o n t o
women scientists for
promoting innovation and creativity for a better and more
sustainable future.
Prof. Rajeev Ahuja, Hon'ble Director, IIT Ropar applauded
the eﬀorts of women scientists at IIT Ropar for ﬁling the
IPRs and technology transfer transactions, leading to
start-up formation and creation of jobs and revenues.
2
World Environment Day 2023
IIT Ropar, in association
with Punjab Energy
Development Agency,
c e l e b r a t e d W o r l d
Environment Day 2023
with the theme of “Beat
Plastic Pollution” to
create a sustainable
future for our planet.
T h e s t u d e n t s f r o m
Schools and Colleges participated in the tree plantation
drive and also in events like poster making and quiz
competition. The tree plantation was done in front of
Super Academic Block of IIT Ropar.
Interaction with Union Minister
Shri Gajendra Singh Shekhawat on
Jal Jeevan Mission
Union Minister of Jal
Shakti, Shri. Gajendra
Singh Shekhawat visited
IIT Ropar on June 2, 2023
and interacted with the
faculty and students on
Jal Jeevan Mission with
the SDG Goal 6.1 that
aims to achieve safe and
a ﬀ o rd a b l e d r i n k i n g
water in the rural household by 2024.
Indian Institute of Technology Ropar
VOLUME 12 ISSUE III AUGUST 2023 | |
To take a walk
down the corridors
of nostalgia, an
Alumni Meet was
organized by IIT
Ropar on April 7,
2023. The occasion
w a s g r a c e d b y
more than 50 Alumni from the 2012 and the 2013 batches.
There were many fun activities organized for all the
Alumni. There was a visit to the transit campus which was
the most enjoyable hour for the visitors. Additionally,
there was an interactive session with faculty and Alumni
where they recollected past memories at IIT Ropar. While
addressing the gathering, the Director underlined and
praised the achievements of Alumni of the Institute in all
spheres of life. He felt that it was a matter of great pride for
the Institute that its Alumni are holding positions of
responsibility in various Government organizations, PSUs,
Private sector, Academic Institutions. He expressed his
delight that many of them are successful entrepreneurs
creating jobs for others. The Meet ended with a cultural
extravaganza and with a promise to meet again while
everyone bid an emotional farewell to each other and the
Institute.
First Alumni Meet
A Talk on Cycling Expedition
in the Himalayas
IIT Ropar organised a
talk to create awareness
about climate change
and its impact on the
Himalayan Glaciers by
Prof. Raaj Ramasakaran
from IIT Bombay and
Prof. Farooq Azam from
IIT Indore.
The Himalayan region harbors some of the most vulnerable
glaciers worldwide, serving as crucial freshwater sources for
millions downstream. However, these glaciers are swiftly
receding due to escalating global temperatures, resulting in
the depletion of vital water supplies and an increased
susceptibility to natural disasters like ﬂash ﬂoods and
landslides.
3
“We are undergoing an era of transformation”, he declared.
While interacting with faculty and students, he added, “IITs
should take the lead role in providing technological support
to all the sectors in the region, particularly on climate
change, water security etc.” He sought the support and
cooperation of IITs to make “Atmanirbhar Bharat” and to
focus on quality & and excellence, strengthening the
research ecosystem and to take responsibility and
opportunity to reverse the water scenario in the country.
International Day of Yoga
International Day of
Yoga was celebrated at
IIT Ropar on June 21,
2 0 2 3 . I I T F a c u l t y
members, Staﬀ and
students participated
a n d e m b r a c e d t h e
practice of yoga as a
powerful tool for holistic
well-being. The theme for International Yoga Day was "Yoga
for Vasudhaiva Kutumbakam" which reﬂects the Hon'ble
Prime Minister Shri Narendra Modi Ji's vision for wellness of
the people across the world as one family.
National Technology Day
IIT Ropar celebrated National Technology Day on June 11,
2023 by organizing an "International Conference on
Agriculture-Centric Computation” on May 11-13, 2023. The
theme for the day was “Integrated Approach in Science and
Technology for a Sustainable Future”.
The event highlighted the achievements of Tech Giants,
Researchers, and Engineers in technology in our country.
The former Prime Minister of India, Shri Atal Bihari
Vajpayee Ji established National Technology Day in 1999 to
commemorate the Pokhran Nuclear Test.
3rd Health Working Group Meeting
IIT Ropar participated
in the 3rd Health
W o r k i n g G r o u p
Meeting's exposition
o n R e s e a r c h a n d
D e v e l o p m e n t o f
T h e r a p e u t i c s ,
V a c c i n e s a n d
Diagnostics. The event
took place from June 4 to 6 at the Hyderabad International
Convention Centre.
The event was graced by the Hon'ble Shri. G. Kishan Reddy
Ji (Minister of Tourism, Culture and Development of the
North Eastern Region), the Hon'ble Shri. S. P. Singh Baghel
Ji (Union Minister of State) Ministry of Health and Family
Welfare, Government of India, and the Hon'ble Shri.
Bhagawanth Khuba Ji (Union Minister of State) Ministry of
Chemicals & Fertilizers.
Green Urja Conclave 2023
IIT Ropar's collaborative
eﬀort with Atulya Ganga
team on Water Quality
Mapping of Rivers Ganga
and Yamuna has been
acknowledged in the
Green Urja Conclave
2023. The team involved
was felicitated by the
Hon'ble Minister of Road
Transport and Highways
o f I n d i a S h r i . N i t i n
Gadkari on June 5, 2023
held at IIT Delhi.

Sixth International Conference of The
Robotics Society
IIT Ropar Organized the
S i x t h I n t e r n a t i o n a l
C o n f e r e n c e o f T h e
R o b o t i c s S o c i e t y -
'Advances in Robotics
2023' For this event, IIT
Ropar welcomed a large
gathering of national
a n d i n t e r n a t i o n a l
delegates, including speakers from the University of
Maryland, Columbia University, University of Calabria, NUS
Singapore, University of Wollongong Australia, various IITs
and NITs, DRDO, CSIR labs from July 5 to 8, 2023. 'Advances in
Robotics 2023' (AIR) is the prestigious ﬂagship conference of
The Robotics Society (TRS) that witnessed a key milestone
this year for completing ten years since its genesis at DRDO
Pune in 2013. Prof Rajeev Ahuja, Director, IIT Ropar
welcomed the guests and delegates and discussed the
aspirations of IIT Ropar as a young IIT to play a vital role in
the advancements of Robotics and AI in the country. Prof.
Santanu Chaudhury, TRS President and Director IIT Jodhpur
highlighted the vision of TRS as an international platform for
promoting Robotics research by bringing together the
academia and the industry.
Commonwealth Professional
Fellows Reunion Day
Nalanda Library, IIT
Ropar in association
with Commonwealth
Professional Fellows
Alumni (UEL Group)
o r g a n i z e d
C o m m o n w e a l t h
Professional Fellows
Reunion Day on July
14, 2023 as well as and a Workshop on Preparing Library
Leaders of Tomorrow: developing Competencies and Skills
on July 15, 2023. The Library and IT professionals from
Chandigarh, Punjab, Haryana and Himachal Pradesh
actively participated in the workshop.
The workshop was mainly focused on the theme of Library
Leadership aimed to address the plethora of challenges
faced by academic libraries and leadership development of
young aspiring librarians who can become catalysts of
change in their respective institutions and in the wider LIS
sector.
SAMRIDHI Startup Conclave
A d y n a m i c
collaboration with
the Department of
Science & Technology
(DST), Government of
India, culminated in
t h e t r i u m p h a n t
h o s t i n g o f t h e
“Strategic Acceleration for Market, Research, Innovation &
Development: a Holistic Initiative for ICPS Startups,” more
commonly known as the SAMRIDHI Conclave. This event,
which unfolded on July 12, 2023, stands as a testament to
the Institute's resolute commitment and a pioneering
milestone in advancing revolutionary strides in
Agriculture and Water Technology Development. The
conclave's trajectory harmoniously aligns with the
overarching National Mission on Interdisciplinary Cyber-
Physical Systems (NM - ICPS).
Prof. Rajeev Ahuja, Director of IIT Ropar, expressed
profound gratitude for the conﬂuence of endeavours
uniting academia, industry, and startups, underscoring
their pivotal role in shaping consequential outcomes. Dr.
Pushpendra P. Singh, Project Director AWaDH, TIH, IIT
Ropar, garnered well-deserved accolades for his
unswerving commitment to advancing AWaDH's mission.
Indian Institute of Technology Ropar

Spray Awareness

The aim of the workshop was to provide high-level insights
into the promising world of thermal spray and exploring its
numerous applications in various industries and Research
and Development. Prof Rajeev Ahuja, Director IIT Ropar
inaugurated the workshop and shared his insights on
thermal spray. Dr Satish Tailor, from MECPL Jodhpur (CoE
Industry Partner) delivered the inaugural talk.

5
Meeting with ARTRAC HQ, Shimla
IIT Ropar and ARTRAC HQ,
Shimla, represented by
the Director, Prof. Rajeev
Ahuja and GOC-in-C Lt.
G e n . S . S . M a h a l ,
respectively, have agreed
to cooperate in various
t r a i n i n g a n d R & D
programs through the Center of Excellence for Studies and
Applied Research in Defence and Security at IIT Ropar.
Key areas of cooperation identiﬁed were Artiﬁcial
Intelligence, fusion of emerging technologies in military
systems, Cognitive Enhancement Psychological tools for
new recruits and various healthcare techs. In the context of
broad technological domains that can serve pan-Army
needs, tech development in specialty textiles, additive
manufacturing and drone training/warfare was
comprehensively discussed.
Science & Technology (S&T) Cluster
The President of India through the O/o PSA, Government
of India, has sanctioned the Northern Region Science &
Technology (S&T) Cluster. This is going to be the ﬁrst
regional S&T Cluster in the country. The other S&T clusters
are mainly city based. The Cluster will be situated in
Chandigarh and will be jointly led by IIT Ropar and Punjab
University, Chandigarh
A Talk on National Research Foundation
Dr. Akhilesh Gupta, Secretary,
SERB - DST, Senior Adviser - DST,
and overall in charge of the
N a t i o n a l M i s s i o n o n
Interdisciplinary Cyber-Physical
Systems (NM-ICPS) visited IIT
Ropar on August 11, 2023 to
deliver a talk and Dr. Gupta
interacted with the faculty
members and Ph.D. students on the topic “National
Research Foundation – a Way Forward to Achieving India's
Global R&D Leadership
Indian Institute of Technology Ropar
VOLUME 12 ISSUE III AUGUST 2023 | |
The O/o PSA will be providing Rs. 10.35 cr as ignition grant
which will be used to setup the cluster and to undertake
the R&D projects. Five thematic areas (Agriculture and
food processing, Pharma/medical devices/health-care,
Indigenous technology development and optimization,
Waste management and wealth from waste, Sustainable
mobility and green energy) have been identiﬁed for this
venture. The cluster will focus on Haryana, Punjab,
Himanchal Pradesh, and J&K through collaboration and
cluster - spoke model.
One Day Research Symposium “CheERS”

C h e m i c a l

Ropar organized a
one-day research
symposium called
CheERS (Chemical
E n g i n e e r i n g
Research Symposium), August 19, 2023. This symposium

G20 SUMMIT
AT AMRITSAR
India assumed a year-long
p r e s i d e n c y o f G 2 0 o n
December 1, 2022 and IIT
Ropar was fortunate enough to
get a chance to host the G20
Education Summit at Amritsar
during March 15-17, 2023 on
the theme of “Strengthening
R esearch and Promoting
Innovation through richer
collaboration.” �e spirit of
India's G20 chairmanship is
manifested in the theme of
'One Earth, One Family, One
Future' enshr ined in the
ancient Sanskrit ethos as 'Vasudahaiva Kutumbakam.' With our core
strength in innovation and collaboration, we have focused on
becoming an agent of Sustainable Development evolution,
promoting inclusive growth and reaching constructive solutions to
various challenges and determining how collaboration between
G20 countries can help revolutionalize progress in science and
technology, space, innovation and start-ups.
�e G20 or Group of 20 is an intergovernmental forum of the
world's major developed and developing economies. It is a
membership of 19 countries, i.e. US, Argentina, Brazil, Australia,
Canada, Mexico, Turkey, Indonesia, South Korea, Japan, China,
Germany, Britain, India, Saudi Arabia, South Africa, Italy, France,
Russia. In addition, European Union(EU), the International
Monetary Fund (IMF), the World Bank, the International
Monetary and Financial Commi�ee and the Development
Commi�ee, the ministers of �nance and the governor of the central
bank also form part of G20.
�is G20 platform at Amritsar has helped us showcase the research
development and potential solutions to various challenges to
achieve sustainable development goals. With a robust start-up
exhibition laid at Amritsar, the institute has evidently expressed the
visible growth of technological innovation and projected India as
the bright spot shining on the Global horizon. During the Summit,
the delegates have appreciated the action-oriented strategies,
leading India particularly in technology with digital public goods
and its governance, self-reliance or Aatma Nirbhar, vaccine
diplomacy, and its �rmness on various geopolitical issues.
We got an exceptional opportunity and a profound responsibility to
display our rich cultural heritage and diversity, tourism potential and
development prowess at Punjab, and the focus on the culture and
values of our society aﬀected the delegtaes positively.

for 2023, IIT Ropar hosted the
“2nd Education Working Group

during March 15-17, 2023 at
Majestic Khalsa College on the
broad theme of “Promoting
R e s e a r c h & I n n o v a t i o n s
�rough Collaboration”. �e event was focused on the identi�cation
of relevant policies and best practices for research and innovations
from the deliberations of G20 member nations. �e G20 delegates
got the �rst hand immersive experience of the vibrant culture, art,
cuisine and warmth of Punjab.
�e G20 delegation, in an a�empt to
perceive the rich heritage, paid obeisance
at the Golden Temple. �e SGPC
honoured the delegation with 'Siropa'
(robe of honour), model of Sri Harmandar
Sahib and books related to the Sikh faith.
Before oﬀering prayers, the delegation visited the community
kitchen at the shrine.
�e participants in the meeting
also included representatives of
international organizations such
as UNESCO, UNICEF, the World Bank and the Organisation for
Economic Co-operation and
Development (OECD), among
others. �e event emphasized
research and innovation as well
as the eﬀect of collaboration on
t h e p e r f o r m a n c e o f G 2 0
member nations.
IIT Ropar lead the Seminar on
s t r e n g t h e n i n g r e s e a r c h
collaborations on the sidelines of
2nd Education Working Group
(EdWG) Meeting on March 15
2023 at the venue.
�e key sessions on research and
innovations would help reduce inequalities inside and between
countries, will promote
innovations for sustainable
agriculture for ge�ing high
yield and reducing food
waste, will enlarge the role
of academia in cheap and

research and innovation and facilitate innovations for
environmentally conscious and
accountable industrialization..

01 \
For years IIT Ropar has embarked on an educational mission
that is meant to be transformative – academically, socially,
and personally. “Collaboration and Innovation” are our
guiding principles, which are reflected in every activity of the
Institute. Moreover, our curriculum clarifies those values and
standards. As you know, this month marks the start of a new
year and the setting of new goals and aspirations, IIT Ropar
family has set common goals to work together with
determination to converge all our expertise and make
optimum use of the power of technologies for the sustainable
development of the Institute and the society at large.
Collaborations with Industry and academia have matured in
2022 in the area of defence and security, Census Data center
and joint academic programme in the field of education and
research.
I hope that 2023 brings
happiness, peace and
wellness to you and
your loved ones. The dawn
of the New Year is the best
t i m e t o r e j o i c e o u r
accomplishments from
the bygone year and to
determine the direction in
which we want to move
for a better tomorrow.
A n d o n t h a t n o t e , I
c o n g r a t u l a t e t h e
graduating students from BTech, MTech, MS, PhD and other
programs, who were awarded their degrees in the 11th
convocation, with whch 2022 had ended for us. They will
certainly go on to make significant contributions to society
and to the world.
The Institute fosters and nurtures leaders of tomorrow who
are capable of making a difference in the society. The strong
faculty-student relations at IIT Ropar have also resulted in
evolving and exploring innovative solutions, developing the
students to face ever demanding challenges in the society.
Nestled in an ecologically invigorating ambience, IIT Ropar
epitomizes a place where talent is nurtured, groomed and
launched into the corporate world. The year ahead may bring
new challenges and opportunities but I am confident that we
will continue to excel in this journey with your continued
support and our unified efforts. I once again wish you all
happiness, health and success in the Year 2023.
Director’s Message
Dear Friends!
th
11 Convocation of the Institute
Prof. Rajeev Ahuja, Director, IIT Ropar presented
his Annual Report and congratulated the faculty,
staff and students. The degrees were offered in the
presence of faculty, staff, students, parents and
eminent personalities. This year, 564 students
graduated from various academic programmes in
IIT Ropar.
The President Gold Medal and the
Director Gold Medal for obtaining the
highest CGPA among the graduating
s t u d e n t s o f t h e B a c h e l o r o f
Technology in the year 2021-22 was
awarded to Mr. Hansin Kishore Ahuja
of Computer Science and Engineering
department.
The Eleventh Annual Convocation of Indian
Institute of Technology, Ropar (IIT Ropar) took
place in December 2022. Sh. Rajinder Gupta,
Founder & Chairman, Trident Group India was the
Chief Guest for this occasion.
Chief Guest Mr. Rajinder Gupta, who
delivered the Convocation Address, shared: "We need knowledgeable leaders like
you - educated experts who can help business and industry understand how to
transform this information into usable intelligence, and how to move from simply
collecting to tactically connecting data to make valuable insights and discoveries.
You will be a critical part of the talent pool needed for the developing nation like
India, to navigate the Big Data landscape effectively and to provide the analytical
skills to harness it fully across many fields pertaining to industries.”
Dr. K. Radhakrishnan, Hon'ble Chairman, Board of Governors, IIT Ropar shared his
words during the convocation, stating that academic excellence is the bedrock of IIT
Ropar. He praised the research ecosystem at the campus, as exemplified by the
research outcomes and publications.
